sections.text:
-Ability Power 180. Damages all enemies 3 times with physical fire damage at success of 80 points.
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Increases the ATK and DEF of all allies by 40% for 60 seconds.
Increases the critical hit chance of all allies by 30% for 60 seconds.
-Casts elevate on your character for 60 seconds.
